page.overview:
What is Animatronic Skins?

are special features in Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery, used for customizing the delivery animatronics' plush suits. They were first introduced on March 12, 2020 during the St. Patrick's Day event with the introduction of Shamrock Freddy. The latest skin to be implemented in the game was on December 13, 2021 during the Dark Circus event with the introduction of Great Escape Golden Freddy.

There are a current total of thirty-nine skins (excluding Clockwork Minireena and the cupcakes) implemented into the game.

Currently, there is a total of sixteen sets of distinctive skins.

The skins are usually introduced in ongoing Delivery Events, however they are only available via limited time. When encountered randomly with lures, their Plush Suits and lures will rarely be given as rewards upon defeated. Their character packs can also be purchased from the store with Faz-Coins or in-app purchases.
